DD4 RE-BASELINE (2026-06-05): DD4 (override-propagation) as originally amended (comments 1-2: HMAC admin-exemption ledger — ael_append/.closure-key/C1-C3) is SUPERSEDED by ADR-0022 identity-based exemption (a SHA is reviewed-equivalent iff its covering merged PR's server-set merged_by.id is in the ruleset bypass-actor set). The identity-based mechanism + rev.3 data-source fix (fetch merged_by via GET /pulls/{n} on the bypass path) is LANDED on main and single-override-validated live (epic comment 4: 7b77 #647->#648, no second override). The HMAC subsystem was retired. So DD4 is DONE (identity-based), with two NON-blocking hardening follow-ups for the 3ee4 enforce-flip: (i) wire test-identity-exemption-equivalence.sh into CI as the P-IDENTITY-EXEMPT liveness gate, and (ii) configure the bypass-actor on the live main ruleset 15629023 (currently bypass_actors=[]).

REMAINING SCOPE (this work): DD1 (tristate gate contract PASS/FAIL/INDETERMINATE + retrofit the named gates), DD2 (durable --resume reconstruct-from-GitHub, /tmp as cache, INC-008 guard), DD3 (INDETERMINATE -> /dso:fp-recovery escalation). Per maintainer direction, completing the resilience-hardening (DD1-3) now. Note: DD1-3 map to no epic SC (epic marks 3ebb 'separable'); doing them per explicit maintainer direction, not as an epic-closure gate.
